title: Lead Healthcare Administrator
description:
Sutherland is seeking a Lead Healthcare Administrator who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Lead Healthcare Administrator, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our general capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute general initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 5+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Stakeholder Management, Analytical Thinking, Team Management, Project Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €30,000 – €50,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

Baxter International is seeking a Senior Graphic Designer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Senior Graphic Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our design capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute design initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 5+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Prototyping, User Research, Accessibility, Stakeholder Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €140,000 – €190,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Principal Mechanical Engineer
description:
Join Nickelodeon as a Principal Mechanical Engineer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Principal Mechanical Engineer with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

- Minimum 9 years of experience as a Principal Mechanical Engineer or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office, Microservices, CI/CD, Analytical Thinking
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: €50,000 – €70,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

Square is seeking a Director of UX Designer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Director of UX Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our design capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute design initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 5+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Project Management, Accessibility, Analytical Thinking, Figma
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €70,000 – €100,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Join Caesars Entertainment as a Senior Project Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Senior Project Manager with strong expertise in marketing. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute marketing projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 6 years of experience as a Senior Project Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Analytics, Google Ads, Leadership, CRM
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: €70,000 – €100,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

- Competitive salary of €30,000 – €50,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Director of Cloud Architect
description:
Join Kent State University as a Director of Cloud Architect and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Director of Cloud Architect with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 10 years of experience as a Director of Cloud Architect or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Git, Python, TypeScript, React
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: €140,000 – €190,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

description:
We are looking for a talented Senior Customer Success Manager to join our dynamic team at VMware. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining general solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work

- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
